outcome: Other complications during pregnancy and delivery
finding: Inactivated COVID-19 vaccination during the peri-pregnancy period was found to be safe for both mothers and their babies, although an association with neonatal jaundice was observed.
mod_finding: This study found that inactivated COVID-19 vaccination during the peri-pregnancy period was not an independent risk factor for premature rupture of membrane.
birth_weight: No difference in neonatal weight between the vaccine and control groups
